name: accessibility-repair
description: Scan a web page for WCAG 2.2 accessibility failures and get the fix for each one.

interface.longDescription: Accessibility Repair loads a public web page in a real browser and runs automated WCAG 2.2 A and AA checks: axe-core, IBM Equal Access, and checks for keyboard focus, dialogs, overlays and age gates, ARIA references, zoom, reflow and text spacing. Each failure comes back with its WCAG criterion, the number of instances, the evidence, the fix, and the guard: what breaks if the fix is applied without care. Results are automated test results for one page at desktop width. They are not a compliance determination.
defaultPrompt: Check https://example.com for WCAG 2.2 accessibility failures.
Scan my homepage for accessibility problems and tell me how to fix them.
